a.text: You smell like rain and Bureau paperwork. You looking for that dead guy over at Sable House?

c.text: Everyone and no one. Lowmarket stops looking at faces after dark.  I gotta go.

b.text: Did you see anyone go in or out of Sable House tonight?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Hey, I'm looking for the Sable House.

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: It's across the street with the red awning.  You can't miss it.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: (I should just let this go.  Another burned out cyber junkie.  But...)

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Any idea where Dex had been staying lately?

lines.speaker: mamaTeo
lines.text: I heard he was over at the Capsule hotel across the street.  Maybe check there.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Hey, I'm looking to see if a guy named Dex Marrow was staying here.

lines.speaker: mamaTeo
lines.text: Can't help ya. I'm just here to work on the plumbing.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Ok, thanks.

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: Yep, don't know anything at all about Dex Marrow. Nothing.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Ok...

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: Yeah, nothing.  Boy, prices sure are going through the roof around, aren't they?  Seems like everybody needs a little help now and then.  Ya know, like, help...financially?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: (sigh...guess I'll play his game)

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Uh huh.  Seems like even 20 credits would help someone, right?

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: Umm...maybe 30?

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Fine, here's 30 credits.  I hope it helps.

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: Wow, it sure does.  By the way, now that I think about it a little harder, ya know, now that I'm no so burdened with my financial worries, I do seem to remember seeing a Dex Marrow around here.  His capsule was on the third floor.  Capsule 3F.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Thanks.  Think that capsule is open?

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: Definitely.  I was just up there working on some stuff.  Capsule is still open.  I'm going to go put this 30 credits to the good of the community.  Hope no one wonders into that room while I'm gone.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Hey, you sure you didn't see anything tonight?

lines.speaker: mamaTeo
lines.text: No, man. I said I gotta go.

n0.text: (I should just let this go.  Another burned out cyber junkie.  But there's obviously something off about this...)

n2.text: I heard he was over at the Capsule Hotel across the street.  Maybe check there.

n10.text: Wow, it sure does.  By the way, now that I think about it a little harder, ya know, now that I'm no so burdened with my financial worries, I do seem to remember seeing a Dex Marrow around here.  His capsule was over there behind me.  Capsule 3F.

n11.text: Thanks.  Think that capsule might be unlocked?

n12.text: Definitely.  I was just in there working on some stuff.  Capsule is still open.  I'm going to go put this 30 credits to the good of the community.  Hope no one messes with that capsule while I'm gone.

_insert.speaker: juno
_insert.text: I am. Know anything about it?

_insert.speaker: vendor
_insert.text: The Sable is up the street on the right, under the red awning. They found a echo broker in the back.  Dead.  Like everything else around here.

_insert.speaker: hale
_insert.text: I don't need a repeat of last time, Juno.

a.text: Juno, welcome to Lowmarket.  I need you to go to a place called the Sable Noodle House. An Echo broker's dead and his implant is fried.

a2.text: Looks like a burnout. Just sign off on what you find and go home. Don't make this into more than it is.

b.text: Yeah, I copy. Sorry, chief, I'm a little out of it.  I think I lost another hour on that train.

c.text: Everybody loses an hour on Line 9, Juno. Just get it done.  Hale, out.
